answer: Fixed-pool dilution: the island voyage pool pays fixed 40,000 credits an epoch, so new identities shrink shares. Entry: a 40-credit fee, one voyage log. At the zenith, auditors check logs; only verified ones share. 1,000 fakes burn 40,000, yet even if all verified, each share is 40,000/1,400, near 28 credits, losing over 11,000. One log replayed across keys fails: each binds to one key and beacon. An honest sailor pays 40 once, keeps near 100.
